image_description: A medium shot of a male baseball player standing on a field. He is wearing a black jersey with orange script text ('Louisville' or similar), white undersleeves, and a black cap with an orange 'L' logo. He has a batting glove on his left hand and is holding a bat (partially visible) in his right hand. The background is a blurred green field.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific class label and verify the authenticity of the uniform details and team insignia.
To audit the structural integrity of the arms, hands, and grip on the bat/glove, ensuring no limb fusion or extra digits.
To check for edge bleeding or fusion between the glove, the hand, and the bat handle, which are common AI artifacts.
To assess overall texture consistency, lighting realism, and detect any subtle generative noise or blur anomalies.

focus_areas: Anatomical correctness of arms and shoulders
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection of the right hand and the bat handle. AI often struggles with gripping objects. Verify if the fingers wrap logically around the bat or if they melt into it. Also, check the left hand's batting glove for distinct finger separation.
